added.eligibility_text: NC resident for tuition purposes; reside in a qualifying rural NC county; graduating NC high school senior enrolling full-time in the fall; minimum cumulative GPA 2.5; plan to enroll at a participating NC public or private college/university; FAFSA Student Aid Index of 15000 or less; commit to returning to a rural NC county after college.
added.notes: Seeded 2026-09-26 by Claude through the Add Award prefill path (Catalog Integrity Task 2.2). Not verified: open the source page before setting trust to verified_local. added.renewal_terms: $3,500 a year for up to four years; renewal needs a Renewal Profile and FAFSA each year, continued need, full-time enrollment, and SAP.
